————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the May 18, 2007/Vaisakha 28, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and
Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Environment and Forests; Health and Family Welfare;
Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
196
Rail projects in Bihar
*621. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of major projects being
implemented by Government in Bihar;
(b) the money allocated, so far, and
whether the amount allocated is enough to
complete the projects on time;
(c) how many railway stations in Bihar
are being upgraded to model Grade-A
status; and
(d) the infrastructural facilities to be
provided under the scheme?
Loss due to fire in the Talcher unit
†*622. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that recently a massive fire incident
had occurred in the closed factory of the
Fertilizers Corporation of India situated at
Talcher under Angul district of Orissa;
(b) if so, the quantum of losses therein;
and
(c) whether it will have any bearing on
the announcement of Government to revive
this factory?
Diversion of PDS items
†*623. SHRI MAHENDRA SAHNI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 53.3 per cent
of wheat and 39 per cent of rice given in
ration under Accelerated PDS and
Antyodaya Yojana is sold in black-market
instead of being given to the needy people
in the country as per the study conducted
by ORG Centre for Social Research;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to check it strictly?
Interest Subvention Scheme
*624. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
introduced an Interest Subvention Scheme
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

197
that aims at providing agricultural loan at
the rate of 7 per cent;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Government of Gujarat
has pointed out certain difficulties to take
advantage of this scheme;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken by Government in
this regard?
Level of mercury in the air in
hospitals
*625. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
high levels of mercury in our country found
in the air in hospitals which threaten the
health of patients and medical staff;
(b) whether it is also a fact that US has
come forward to help our country to reduce
such high levels of mercury containment;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Problems of Agri-extension Services
*626. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
tackle the problems of Agri-extension
Services such as poor reach to fields, lack
of specialization, knowledge/skills on
markets and their operations, etc.;
(b) if so, whether any step to encourage
private extension research and farmer's
training is contemplated;
(c) if so, the details of all private
companies which would be roped in; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Setting up captive power plant
*627. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) the average annual requirement of
electricity of the Railways;
(b) the charges of electricity for
operation of trains per unit;
(c) whether the Railways have decided
to set up a captive power plant in
collaboration with NTPC with a view to
get power at cheaper rates; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Making barren land cultivable
†*628. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the cultivable land in hectares at
present in the country;
(b) the barren land in hectares and the
steps taken by Government during the last
five years to make it cultivables, State-wise;
and
(c) the total amount spent during the
last five years for converting the barren
land cultivable, State-wise?
Persons employed in khadi textile
industry
†*629.SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 13.16 lakh
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

198
persons were employed in khadi textile
industry in the country during 1994-95
whereas this number has declined to 8.70
lakhs only during 2005-06;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard; and
(c) the reasons for less production in
the industry during the said period in spite
of the efforts made by Government for its
expansion and development?
Introduction of new trains for
Himachal Pradesh

Total number of questions — 155
1101
Hiring of tuna training boats by
CIFNET
4742. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
permission to the Central Institute of
Fisheries Nautical and Engineering Training
(CIFNET) to hire tuna training boats from
Norway and other countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how many people would be trained
on one such hired tuna boat in a year;
(d) whether it would be cheaper to send
Indian youths for training abroad at much
lower costs; and
(e) the steps proposed to study the
costs of training with hired boats, etc. by
CIFNET?
Food security
4743. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that food security
is coming under renewed strain with
growing shortfalls in foodgrains and
vegetables;
(b) if so, the details of production and
requirement of foodgrains during the last
two years; and
(c) whether it is a fact that private
companies have started to purchase
foodgrains directly from the farmers at a
much higher rate than the rate fixed by
Government and if so, how much purchase
these companies have made, so far, and at
what rate?
Elections to the general body of
Kendriya Bhandar
4744. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the election to the general
body/delegates of Kendriya Bhandar was
held in 1999 for three years and if so, the
reasons for not holding the elections in
2002; and
(b) what action is proposed to be taken
against the central registrar of MSCS and
Kendriya Bhandar for failing to perform
their duties in the matter of holding the
election to the general body in time?

1102
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Election to the board of directors
4745. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as per the provisions of
sub section (5) of section 45 of MSCS Act,
2002, the term of office of elected directors
shall be five years from the date of the
election;
(b) whether the election to the board of
directors of Kendriya Bhandar was held in
2003 by the expired general body; and
(c) if so, when the election to the board
should be held now?
Bio-fertilizers versus chemical
fertilizers
†4746. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether role of fertilizers has been
contemplated in view of declining
production capacity of land;
(b) whether comparative study of
effects of dung and other bio-fertilizers
compared to chemical fertilizers has also
been contemplated; and
(c) whether a suggestion of developing
a system of large scale distribution of
domestic fertilizers after their collection in
small packets is under consideration?
2007 as the year of farmers
4747. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have any proposal to declare the year 2007
as the year of farmers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether some State Governments
have already declared the year as such;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the special steps proposed to be
taken by Government to alleviate the
problems being faced by farmers in the
country during this year?
National Agriculture Innovation
Project
4748. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the National
Agriculture Innovation Project;
(b) how it would help in agricultural
research and transfer of new technologies;
(c) the desired objectives of the
schemes; and
(d) how it would increase the access of
these modern technologies to the farmers?
Crop damage
†4749. SHRI MAHENDRA SAHNI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
gales, followed by rains and hailstorms, have
caused extensive damage to farmers' crops
in several States including Bihar, last month;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the said
rains and hailstorms have also caused
damage to life and livestock; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, with
support given/being given by Government
to the farmers State-wise and district-wise?

1103
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
